title: Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) Terms: Cancellation and Reduction Windows
content:
Under new-commerce terms, a commitment on a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription can be undone only briefly.

## Terms

**1. Whole-subscription cancellation.** A subscription may be cancelled in full only within the plan's cancellation window, counted in hours after the cancellation window opens.

**2. Reduction that names no source seat addition.** A reduction that names no source seat addition must be submitted within the cancellation window, counted in hours after the cancellation window opens.

**3. Reduction of added licenses.** A reduction of licenses added by a seat addition, which names that seat addition as its source, must be submitted within the plan's window for reducing added licenses, counted in hours after that seat addition is submitted. Such a reduction may remove no more licenses than that addition added.

**4. Counting the window.** The window is counted in elapsed hours from the opening moment. A request submitted at the exact closing minute is inside it. The cancellation window opens at the purchase moment, and again at 00:00 on the first day of every renewal term. The opening moment of the subscription's window, and the submission moment of a seat addition, are read from the system records.

**5. After the windows close.** Licenses can be neither cancelled nor reduced until the term ends. The client may only schedule a lower renewal quantity or turn auto-renew off. A P1M term ends at its next cycle end when auto-renew is turned off, because the plan allows a P1M term to be ended that way.

**6. Former refund clause, no longer in force.** This clause is no longer in force as written: "A cancellation or in-window reduction is refunded where the plan refunds window reductions: the unit price times the licenses removed times the number of calendar days from the date of submission through the last day of the current billing cycle inclusive, divided by the days in that cycle, rounded half up to the cent, credited to the next invoice."

- On a subscription whose billing cycle runs its whole term (a P1M term, or a P1Y term billed annually), an in-window reduction is credited under the reduction credit schedule, and a whole-subscription cancellation is refunded under the cancellation schedule.
- On any other subscription, where the plan refunds window reductions, a reduction or a cancellation is still refunded at the unit price times the licenses removed times the calendar days from the date of submission through the last day of the current billing cycle inclusive, divided by the days in that cycle, rounded half up to the cent.
- Every in-window reduction and every whole-subscription cancellation refund is credited to the invoice that billed the cycle it refunds, not to the next invoice.

**7. Removals never refunded.** Licenses removed at expiry or by a renewal reduction are never refunded.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical times, 168-hour window)

| Window opens | Request submitted | Inside the window? |
|---|---|---|
| Monday 10:00 (purchase moment) | following Monday 10:00 | Yes. This is the exact closing minute. |
| Monday 10:00 (purchase moment) | following Monday 10:01 | No |
| 00:00 on the first day of a renewal term | 23:59 on the seventh day of that term | Yes |
| Seat addition submitted Thursday 16:20 | reduction naming it, following Thursday 16:20 | Yes, for no more licenses than that addition added |

superseded_clauses: A cancellation or in-window reduction is refunded where refund_on_window_reduction is true: unit_price_usd times the licenses removed times the number of calendar days from the date part of effective_at through the last day of the current billing cycle inclusive, divided by the days in that cycle, rounded half up to the cent, credited to the next invoice.
